My father passed away and left money for my mother for her expenses. Does my mother need to give zakah on the money that my father left for my mother's expense? 2921 views Q. I found some money (1 note of Bangladeshi 500 Taka, equivalent to US $7) at the Masjid premise (that leads to the entrance/exit of the Masjid and Madrasa), on January 18, 2008. Instantly I enquired to few people like Muazzin, Khadem of Masjid and some labours whether they lost any money. They said 'NO'. I thought it was lost from any worker (Madrasa-construction work was going on ) and hence enquired my best but found no one claiming the money. Then I requested the Muazzin to make a decleration after Isha Farz Salaah among the Musallis regarding the lost money. He did so. But no one came or claimed. Then I asked a local Ulama regarding the matter and he replied, I should wait for 2 months. If in the mean time no one came to claim the money, I should give the money to poor people. 1 (one) month has already passed. I'm confused about what to do with that note. Please provide me answers for the following queries on the basis of the written matter: 1). Should I really wait for another 1 month (total 2 months) to find the owner of the money? 2). What other types of decleration should I make to find the owner? Should I make some posters and paste them on the Masjid building? 3). If I can give the money to the poor right now, waiting no further, Should I give all the money to a single poor man/woman or I can give among 50 people at same or more & less proportionate. 4). If someone asks me for a loan of 500 Taka, Can I give him that note of 500 Taka since it's in my pocket for long 1 month without being used , finding no owner? Inshallah I can give the same amount if the real owner claims the money after I give the money to someone as loan. Please, read carefully and provide all the necessary and possible annwers with available options I have. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 40644 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: I am earning small salary which is not enough for my family for one month as my wife having 9 tola gold Question: I am earning small salary which is not enough for my family for one month as my wife having 9 tola gold. So I give zakah every year for that gold. Please explain by Shariah law. Answer ID: 40644 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1171/755/H=1433) You are not responsible to pay it. However if you pay it with the permission of your wife then it shall be paid. You have the right to excuse from paying it. In this case it shall be wajib on wife to pay the zakah of her gold. Yes, if the wife is not the owner of that gold rather you are its owner and you have borrowed the gold to wife only for use then in this case it shall be wajib on you to pay its zakah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
